MEMORANDUM

THE WHITE HOUSE
WASHINGTON

October 31, 1979

MEMORANDUM FOR: THE PRESIDENT
FROM: DAVID AARON
SUBJECT: Iran Demonstrations

Thursday is a religious holiday in Tehran, and the authorities have called for a massive religious/political demonstration to protest U.S. policy and the presence of the Shah in the United States. Police in Tehran anticipate up to one million demonstrators. The program calls for public prayers and a rally in the working class district in South Tehran, followed by a march into town.
